rationale.NVDA: Rubin platform ramp through 2026; hyperscaler capex guides were still rising at cutoff.
rationale.AVGO: Custom-ASIC (XPU) backlog including the ~10GW OpenAI collaboration announced late 2025.
rationale.TSM: Effective monopoly on leading-edge nodes; N2 volume ramp scheduled for 2026; pricing power.
rationale.MU: HBM and conventional DRAM supercycle; capacity effectively sold out for 2026 at cutoff.
rationale.GOOGL: Gemini 3 momentum and accelerating external TPU demand as of late 2025.
rationale.MSFT: Azure AI growth and OpenAI commercial relationship; record capex converting to revenue.
rationale.META: AI-driven ad-engine gains funding aggressive infrastructure buildout.
rationale.AMD: MI450 ramp plus the 6GW OpenAI supply agreement (Oct 2025) landing in 2026.
rationale.GEV: Gas turbines and grid equipment sold out for years on datacenter power demand.

risk_note: Deliberately high-beta, heavily concentrated in the AI-infrastructure trade. If the AI capex cycle cracked in H1 2026, this basket would underperform badly. That is the bet accepted to try to beat the index.
